decisions: TikTok inbox drafts (tiktokDraft) block batch creation: batch_items has no column for the draft flag yet, so creating would publish without the sound
Voice lint: privacy findings are always errors; hype, CTAs and {{placeholders}} are errors; exclamation marks, all-caps and a missing 'Not financial advice.' are warnings
weekly-batch never assigns times (F1's scheduler does); without times a draft can be checked but not created
Lint lives in packages/research so this run didn't touch packages/core while F1/F4 run; F2/F3 can move it
Report recommends only when a group AND the rest each have n>=3, a platform has >=6 posts, and lift is >=1.25x or <=0.75x; max 8 recommendations; identical post sets shown once

Trials: 'share' only if views >= your regular-reel median and engagement and skip rate aren't worse; 'don't share' only after 72 h and under 0.5x; otherwise 'wait'. No verdict before 24 h or with fewer than 3 regular reels. Only trials from the last 14 days are listed
Missed snapshot checkpoints aren't back-filled under an old label
blocked: Guard hook blocks any Bash command that mentions docs/overnight.md or CLAUDE.md (even cat), and matches 'sed' inside words like 'used' next to '.env' text; used the Read/Write tools instead
